title: Bolna vs Retell: Finding the Right Voice AI Platform
summary: Bolna vs Retell AI compared on pricing, scalability, customization, performance, reporting and setup, to help you choose a voice AI platform.
body_markdown:
Voice AI is becoming an essential part of how businesses communicate and operate. It is being used in healthcare to remind patients about appointments, in education to answer student queries, and in customer support to handle thousands of calls every day. Many industries are now turning to voice automation to make communication faster, easier, and more personal.


The value of Voice AI automation lies in its consistency. It can respond instantly, stay available at any hour, and keep conversations accurate no matter the scale. This helps companies improve customer satisfaction while reducing the workload on human teams.


Among the growing number of solutions, Bolna and Retell have emerged as two platforms that approach voice automation in distinct ways. Both aim to make AI-driven conversations sound natural and useful, but they differ in pricing, regional focus and deployment options.


This article looks at Bolna vs Retell to understand how each platform supports modern communication and which one fits better for businesses ready to adopt Voice AI.


*Competitor details checked against their official websites on 26 October 2026.*

## **What Problems Businesses Face with Voice AI**


Many businesses struggle when integrating voice AI, not because the idea is weak but because real-world challenges often get in the way.


- **Language diversity:** Supporting multiple regional and global languages can be difficult. Many AI systems still find it hard to understand accents or local dialects.
- **Latency and response quality:** Delayed or robotic replies make conversations feel unnatural. Real interactions need speed, accuracy, and clear tone.
- **Scalability:** Managing large call volumes without losing quality requires strong infrastructure and consistent performance.
- **Data privacy and control:** Voice AI platforms must protect sensitive information such as financial or medical data while maintaining compliance standards.


The voice AI agents market is projected to reach[USD 47.5 billion by 2034,](https://market.us/report/voice-ai-agents-market/) driven by the growing use of automation across different sectors. These challenges highlight the need for a platform that balances technology, reliability, and ease of use.

## **Meet the AI Voice Agent Platforms**


Several platforms are now helping businesses bring voice automation into everyday operations. Each one focuses on a slightly different aspect of communication, from handling customer calls to managing large outreach campaigns. Bolna and Retell are two of the most recognized names in this space, both aiming to make AI-driven conversations more natural and effective.


### Bolna: A Feature-Packed Solution for Business Growth


[Bolna](https://www.bolna.ai/) is an[Indian voice AI platform](https://www.bolna.ai/blog/indian-voice-ai-platform-for-businesses) built for businesses that want automation to feel natural and human. It helps companies manage customer calls, schedule appointments, run surveys, and handle follow-ups through real conversations that sound clear and confident.


The platform supports 20+ languages, including Hindi, Hinglish, Tamil and Telugu, making it easy for businesses to connect with customers across different regions and cultures. This multilingual strength gives Bolna an edge in markets where local communication builds trust.


Bolna AI. ([Source](https://www.bolna.ai/) )


Bolna delivers a user-friendly and feature-rich experience designed to help businesses grow. From pre-made agents to advanced batch calling capabilities, Bolna provides all the tools needed to automate and simplify operations smoothly.


With Bolna, you can:


- Use pre-built agents for quick setup and faster deployment.
- Schedule appointments easily with voice-based automation.
- Scale large outreach campaigns through advanced batch calling.


Bolna focuses on both performance and privacy.[Voice agents](https://www.bolna.ai/agents) can be created in minutes, handle thousands of calls at once, and maintain fast response times. The platform also includes analytics, transcripts, and call recordings to help teams review and improve results.

### **Retell**


Retell is a platform for building, testing, deploying and monitoring voice and chat agents. Teams can build in a no-code dashboard, with either a single prompt or a conversation flow, or work through its API, SDKs and MCP server. Agents can run on US and Canadian numbers bought from Retell, on your own carrier through SIP, or on a website through its web widget.


Retell AI.


Retell lists 55 languages, including Hindi, Tamil, Marathi and Kannada, though coverage depends on the speech provider you choose. It also publishes SIP guides for Twilio, Telnyx, Vonage, Avaya, Genesys and Five9.


## ****Bolna vs Retell AI: Key Comparisons****


Both Bolna and Retell are designed to make voice automation easier for businesses, but the way they perform and the features they offer are quite different. Here are some of the key areas where Bolna and Retell differ.


### **1. Pricing and Scalability**


Bolna starts at $0.06 per minute on pay-as-you-go, with telephony and the platform fee added per minute, making it ideal for companies that handle a large number of calls each day. Retell lists $0.07 to $0.31 per minute for voice agents: $0.055 per minute for voice infrastructure plus the LLM and voice you pick, with telephony at $0.015 per minute in listed countries and SIP trunking free. New Retell accounts get $10 in free credits and 20 concurrent calls.


Bolna also supports advanced batch calling and provides ready-made agents for multiple industries, helping teams grow without technical challenges.


### **2. Customization and Functionality**


Customization is one of the strongest differences between Bolna and Retell. Bolna offers a simple bot builder, allowing users to adjust prompts and workflows without any coding experience. This makes it easy to create voice agents that reflect a company’s tone and communication style.


Bolna also provides a wide range of pre-built templates for both inbound and outbound use cases, including recruitment, healthcare, real estate, and food services. Teams can deploy these agents quickly and make small edits to fit their needs.


Retell's dashboard offers a single-prompt builder and a conversation-flow builder, and developers can also configure agents through its API and SDKs.


### **3. Performance and Reporting**


Performance plays a key role in how effective a voice AI system can be. Bolna targets under 600 milliseconds end to end, allowing calls to feel natural and uninterrupted.


Bolna also includes detailed analytics and reporting features directly on the platform. Users can view call summaries, transcripts, and recordings in one place, helping teams track performance and make improvements easily. Retell also includes tools to test and monitor agents.


### **4. Support and Setup Experience**


Customer support and ease of setup can make a major difference in how quickly a business gets value from voice AI. Bolna offers a Slack community, support email and personalized demo sessions to guide users through setup and agent creation, and the Pilot plan adds four 1:1 calls with the team. Most agents can be deployed within minutes, even by non-technical users.


Bolna’s intuitive interface and quick-start tools make it easier for any team to begin using voice automation with confidence and minimal effort.


### **5. Security and Data Privacy**


Security plays a crucial role when businesses manage customer data through voice AI. Bolna ensures that all call data, transcripts, and recordings are handled securely and remain protected within the platform. It also follows strong data protection standards, giving companies more confidence when dealing with sensitive information.


Retell lists SOC 2 Type 1 and Type 2, HIPAA and GDPR compliance, and offers a self-signed BAA at no extra fee. It does not currently operate services in the EU. For organizations in regulated sectors, Bolna offers Indian data residency and on-premise deployment, so call data can stay in their own environment.


## **What Makes Bolna Stand Out for Businesses**


Bolna stands out as a complete and reliable voice AI platform for both growing and established businesses. It combines fast performance, flexible customization, and multilingual communication to create an experience that fits real business needs. Companies can handle calls, automate tasks, and reach customers in their preferred languages while keeping every interaction clear and efficient.


Unlike platforms that require heavy setup or technical expertise, Bolna focuses on simplicity and speed. Teams can deploy agents within minutes, run large-scale campaigns, and track performance directly through the platform. With its affordable pricing, round-the-clock support, and strong data protection standards, Bolna gives businesses the tools to communicate better and scale faster.


For organizations that value quality, control, and accessibility, Bolna delivers a voice AI experience that is both powerful and easy to manage.


## **How to Choose the Right Voice AI Platform** for Your needs


Choosing a voice AI platform depends on what matters most to your business. Some companies look for fast setup and affordable pricing, while others need language flexibility, scalability, or detailed performance insights. The right choice should balance all these factors while fitting easily into your existing workflows.


When evaluating options like Bolna and Retell, consider how well the platform understands your customers, supports multilingual communication, and maintains call quality under high volumes. It should also give you clear visibility through analytics and make deployment simple for any team.


Bolna checks these boxes with a focus on accessibility, speed, and real results. Whether you are a startup looking to automate calls or an enterprise aiming to scale customer engagement, Bolna offers the reliability and support needed to grow confidently.

Absolutely. Bolna includes voice automation tools like batch calling, pre-built agent templates, and easy scalability for outbound sales, surveys, and feedback campaigns.
